title: C4 tree card (c4: card/1)
description: A tree's card, .c4/card.yaml at the tree's root: what the tree is, where it came from and under what licence. Forms and records show it; nothing enforces it. The tree's identity is its C4 ID, card included, so two snapshots of one repository are two trees.

name.description: The tree's short name, as tools and images name it (depth-anything-v2-small).

title.description: The tree's name in words (Depth Anything V2, small).

format.description: How a runtime reads the tree: hf-transformers, diffusers, gguf, onnx, python, or another runtime's name.

base.description: The tree this one was made from (a LoRA's base model), by its C4 ID.

source.description: Where the tree came from: a hub at a pinned commit, or a job on the farm (job:). Left out for a tree a person uploaded, which is kept data, not a cache.

licence.description: The tree's licence, as information: an SPDX ID, or the address of its terms (terms:).

hub.description: The source, by its name on the farm (huggingface).

type.description: What kind of repository it is on the hub. Default model.

revision.description: The commit the import read, never a branch or a tag: a ref is resolved once, before anything is fetched.

files.description: Each file by its path in the tree: the hub's own hash beside its C4 ID.

sha256.description: A large file's SHA-256, as the hub lists it.

gitBlob.description: A small file's git blob hash, as the hub lists it.

job.description: The job that made the tree: <project>/<job>@<uid>. Its lineage is in the job's records.
